## Activity

During March 2025, Central Eye Clinic completed 200 captures. This activity represents the month’s recorded screening workload at the site. The service continued to process image captures through the routine operational pathway, with the completed total providing the basis for subsequent image-quality review and grading.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 7 were marked ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 3.5. The result identifies the proportion of images that could not proceed through grading and may support ongoing review of capture practice, image quality, and any operational factors affecting image usability. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 54 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day, indicating that the midpoint of reported grading waits remained within the expected operational timeframe for the month. Together, the referable result count and the grading lag provide a concise view of clinical review activity following image capture. These figures should be considered alongside the overall capture volume and the ungradable result rate when monitoring site performance.
